notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Bloodthirsty Ogre.
Bloodthirsty Ogre does not have summoning sickness.
You control a Demon.
description:
Activate Bloodthirsty Ogre's second ability by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Bloodthirsty Ogre triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
